payload.explanation:
This entry for 2,000.00 to account 1110 Cash and Cash Equivalents and 7310 FX Gain/Loss - Unrealized may cause a double-counting of FX revaluation, and the amount does not match expected revaluation calculations.
- The system already translates the EUR, GBP balances of account 1110 Cash and Cash Equivalents, so this 2,000.00 entry to account 7310 FX Gain/Loss - Unrealized would count the same FX gain or loss twice.
- The booked amount of 2,000.00 does not match the expected revaluation of 10,730.20 (period-end versus average rate) or 19,809.60 (period-end versus opening rate). The GBP currency was excluded from expected amounts because a required rate was missing.
Next step: Confirm with finance who owns FX revaluation; if the system translation stands, reject this entry. Also, ask the preparer for the revaluation workings and which rate basis they used.

findings.message: The system already translates the EUR, GBP balances of 1110 Cash and Cash Equivalents at the period-end rate (or the configured fallback where one is missing), so this 2,000.00 entry to 7310 FX Gain/Loss - Unrealized would count the same FX gain or loss twice.
findings.suggested_action: Confirm with finance who owns FX revaluation (Clarifying Q1) before approving; if the system translation stands, reject this entry.
findings.title: FX revaluation would be double-counted

findings.message: Booked 2,000.00 matches neither 10,730.20 (period-end vs average rate) nor 19,809.60 (period-end vs opening rate). Excluded from the expected amounts (GBP): the rate table lacks a period-end, average or opening rate needed to value it.
findings.suggested_action: Ask the preparer for the revaluation workings and which rate basis they used.
findings.title: Revaluation amount does not match either rate basis

response.reason: The explanation clearly identifies two distinct issues with specific amounts and accounts, and provides actionable next steps for resolution.
